About Us​
We are a state-of-the-art ethanol production facility that utilizes over 36.5 million bushels of corn per year to produce about 110 million gallons of denatured ethanol and produce about 600,000 tons of modified wet distillers’ grain per year which is fed by area cattle feeders. We employee over 60 full-time employees from the surrounding communities.
